documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Tinna Rubber and Infrastructure Limited reported its best-ever quarterly profitability for Q1 FY27, with EBITDA exceeding INR30 crores and PAT surpassing INR20 crores. Management highlighted progress on capacity expansions across tire crushing, micronized rubber powder, and recycled carbon black, alongside strategic global expansions in Chile, South Africa, Saudi Arabia, and Oman. The company maintained its Vision 2029 targets of reaching INR1,000 crores in revenue while keeping EBITDA margins over 18%. Tinna Rubber and Infrastructure Limited reported record quarterly performance for Q1 FY27, with consolidated revenue increasing by 20% year-on-year to Rs. 156 Cr and EBITDA expanding by 63% to Rs.

guidance.claim: The company targets revenue of INR1,000 crores by FY29 while maintaining a 25% plus revenue CAGR, 33% plus profitability CAGR, EBITDA margins over 18%, and ROCE exceeding 30%.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, we remain focused on delivering our Vision 2029 objectives through capacity expansions, new product development, sustainability-led investments and on expanding our global footprint, we are targeting presence across 10 locations and revenue of INR1,000 crores by FY29, while maintaining 25% plus revenue CAGR, 33% plus profitability CAGR and EBITDA margins over 18% and ROCE exceeding 30%.

guidance.claim: Management stated that an EBITDA margin of 18% to 20% can be delivered in their business.
guidance.quote: So when you blend that with the efficiencies, overall margins of 18% to 20% is what we believe can be delivered in a business like ours, and that is what has played out well in Q1.

guidance.claim: Management reiterated guidance for the current financial year on the top line between INR670 crores and INR700 crores.
guidance.quote: Yes. So I think we have reiterated the guidelines for this current financial year is somewhere around INR670 crores to INR700-odd crores on the top line side, though we wish to maintain the kind of margin profile, what we have achieved in the Q1, but to stabilize somewhere 18 plus to 20 in between as we feel is achievable.

guidance.claim: The steel abrasives business is expected to achieve approximately 30% volume growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: The steel abrasives business is expected to achieve ~30% volume growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: The polymer composite and masterbatch business is expected to contribute around 10% to FY27 revenue.
guidance.quote: This business vertical is expected to contribute around 10% to FY27 revenue.

guidance.claim: Management expects PCMB contribution to overall turnover to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect the contribution from the PCMB business to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27, supported by strong business momentum.

guidance.claim: The company aims to achieve revenue of INR1,000 crores while maintaining EBITDA margins of over 18% under Vision 2029.
guidance.quote: We aim to achieve revenue of INR1,000 crores while maintaining EBITDA margins of over 18%.

guidance.claim: The company expects an overall revenue growth of 20% to 25% in FY27 compared to the previous year.
guidance.quote: What I can tell you on overall revenue is we are expecting about 20% to 25% growth in revenue in FY27 from the previous year.

guidance.claim: Management forecasts revenue of approximately INR50 crores to INR55 crores from the rCB and TPO plants in FY27.
guidance.quote: So our projection for this RCB and TPO plant for the FY27 is somewhere around INR50 crores-INR55-odd crores for the FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: India recorded a strong 35% Y-o-Y growth in tire crushing volumes, while operations in Oman were temporarily impacted by the West Asia conflict.
demand_outlook.quote: India recorded a strong 35% Y-o-Y growth in tire fishing volumes, while operations in Oman were temporarily impacted by the West Asia conflict, resulting in relatively subdued volumes.

demand_outlook.claim: Sequential volumes for India moderated by 10% due to lower crumb requirement following softer consumer segment demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Sequential volumes for India moderated by 10% due to lower crumb requirement following softer consumer segment demand.

demand_outlook.claim: The Infrastructure and Industrial segments recorded volume growth of 33% and 27% respectively.
demand_outlook.quote: In Q1 FY27, the Infrastructure and Industrial segments recorded volume growth of 33% and 27%, respectively, while the Steel and Consumer segment witnessed a decline in volumes.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports volume delivered a robust 46% Y-o-Y growth supported by a healthy order pipeline.
demand_outlook.quote: Exports volume delivered robust 46% Y-o-Y growth despite global economic headwinds, supported by a healthy order pipeline.

demand_outlook.claim: The long-term outlook for rubberized bitumen remains robust, supported by the government's continued focus on reducing import dependence.
demand_outlook.quote: While our Bitumen Emulsion business was impacted by supply constraints and subdued market demand, the long-term outlook for rubberized bitumen remains robust, supported by government continued focus on reducing import dependence.

demand_outlook.claim: Consumer segment revenue grew by 23% despite a marginal decline in volumes reflecting price corrections.
demand_outlook.quote: Consumer segment revenue grew by 23% despite a marginal decline in volumes, reflecting the impact of price correction.

demand_outlook.claim: The infrastructure segment witnessed moderation during the year due to factors affecting modifier demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Steel segment remained stable on Y-o-Y basis, while volumes increased by 8%, the company also appointed as an exclusive authorized distributor for Zibo TAA Metal Technology Company Limited of China for steel abrasive distribution across India, with the steel abrasive business expected to deliver 30% volume growth in the FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects temporary reduction in the infrastructure business during Q1 and Q2 due to bitumen availability.
demand_outlook.quote: One is we expect some reduction possibly in the infra business during Q1, Q2 of this year. And that is probably, it will be because of less availability of bitumen. Because of that, roadworks, I think, are generally suffering. As a result, the demand for our modifier may also suffer in Q1, Q2.

capex_expansion.claim: During Q1 of FY27, the company executed INR27 crores of capex as part of a broader investment plan of around INR100 crores across FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: During Q1 of FY27, we have executed INR27 crores of capex as part of our broader investment plan of around INR100 crores across FY27 and '28, strengthening our growth and operational capabilities.

capex_expansion.claim: The 3,500 metric ton per annum MRP capacity expansion is on track for commissioning by Q3 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The ongoing 3,500 metric ton per annum MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 of FY '27, increasing the company's total MRP capacity to 20,000 tons per annum, which it is our belief is the largest capacity of MRP in the world.

capex_expansion.claim: The tyre pyrolysis oil facility at Varle commenced trial in Q1 of FY27 and expects commercial sales in Q2 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The tyre pyrolysis oil facility at Varle commenced trial in Q1 of FY '27, and it is expected to commence commercial sales in Q2 of FY '27 with operations stabilizing by Q3 of FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Land has been allocated in Saudi Arabia for a proposed 24,000 tons per annum recycling facility.
capex_expansion.quote: In Saudi Arabia, land has been allocated to the company for a proposed facility of 24,000 tons per annum by recycling facility.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed Rs. 27 Cr of capex in Q1 FY27 against the planned approximately Rs. 100 Cr investment over FY27-FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: Completed Rs. 27 Cr. of capex in Q1 FY27 against the planned ~Rs. 100 Cr. investment over FY27–FY28.

capex_expansion.claim: The ongoing 3,500 MTPA MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The ongoing 3,500 MTPA MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 FY27, increasing the Company's total MRP capacity to 20,000 MTPA.

capex_expansion.claim: Additional capacity of 12,000 TPA at Gannaur, Haryana, has been commissioned in Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Additional capacity of 12,000 TPA at Gannaur (Sonipat), Haryana, has been commissioned in Q1FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its tire-crush capacity in India by 9% to 185,000 tons in FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: We continue to strengthen our processing capabilities during FY26 and expanded our tire-crush capacity in India by 9% to 185,000 tons.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure exceeded INR100 crores during FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term growth strategy, we incurred capital expenditure of over INR100 crores during FY26.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has earmarked another INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: We remain committed to investing in the business and have earmarked a further INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and '28.

capex_expansion.claim: The polymer compounding facility in Haryana is being enhanced to reach 18,000 tons per annum by the end of Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: In line with our expansion strategy, we are enhancing the capacity of our polymer compounding facility in Haryana, which is expected to reach 18,000 tons per annum by the end of Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The Varale plant has reached a capacity utilization of 80%.
capex_expansion.quote: The Varale plant, the newest of our plants, has now reached capacity utilization of 80%.

margins_costs.claim: During the quarter, the company achieved record financial performance with EBITDA margins of over 21% and PAT margins of more than 13% on both stand-alone and consolidated bases.
margins_costs.quote: During the quarter, we achieved record financial performance with EBITDA exceeding INR30 crores, PAT surpassing INR20 crores, EBITDA margins of over 21% and PAT margins of more than 13% on both stand-alone and consolidated basis.

margins_costs.claim: The blended working capital days for the business is 50 days.
margins_costs.quote: We have -- our blended working capital days is 50, and that is fairly consistent actually for our business over the last 2 to 3 years.

margins_costs.claim: Renewable energy has contributed savings of INR 1.19 Cr for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Renewable energy (Solar Power) has contributed savings of INR 1.19 Cr for Q1FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Tinna Rubber delivered robust EBITDA margins of over 17% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: FY26 was another year of strong execution for Tinna Rubber, despite geopolitical uncertainties and a dynamic operating environment, we achieved record tire processing volumes and delivered robust EBITDA margins of over 17%.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone EBITDA and PAT margins expanded by 286 bps and 161 bps to 17.2% and 10% respectively.
margins_costs.quote: On a standalone basis, revenue remained largely stable at INR533 crores, while EBITDA and PAT margin expanded by 286 bps and 161 bps, respectively to 17.2% and 10%, reflecting our strong operational performance and sustained efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved by 206 bps to 17.1%.
margins_costs.quote: On a console basis, EBITDA margin improved by 206 bps to 17.1%, while revenue and PAT grew marginally by 8% and 9%, respectively.

margins_costs.claim: Solar capacity was increased by more than 3x to 4.48 megawatts, with nearly 50% of power requirements expected from renewables from FY27.
margins_costs.quote: During FY26, we significantly expanded our renewable energy footprint increasing solar capacity by more than 3x from 1.23 megawatt to 4.48 megawatt. Nearly 50% of our power requirements are expected to be met through renewable sources from FY27 onwards, supporting both our ESG objectives and cost efficiency efforts.

orders_capacity.claim: The company currently has a tire crushing capacity of 185,000 tons per annum in India.
orders_capacity.quote: We currently have a tire crushing capacity of 185,000 tons per annum in India and continue to strengthen our processing capabilities.

orders_capacity.claim: The PCMB division's initial 6,000-ton-per-annum capacity is operating at 82% utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: The division's initial 6,000-ton-per-annum capacity operates -- is operating at 82% utilization, while the commissioning of the expanded facility in Haryana has increased our total capacity to 18,000 tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured a 15,000 tons rubberized bitumen processing order for execution in FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: The company also secured a 15,000 tons of rubberized bitumen processing order for execution in FY27.

orders_capacity.claim: Tinna achieved an all-time high tire processing volume in FY26 with capacity utilization at 90% for India operations and 85% for Oman.
orders_capacity.quote: Tinna achieved all-time high tire processing volume in FY26 with capacity utilization remaining strong at 90% for India operation and 85% for Oman.

orders_capacity.claim: Tire crushing volumes increased by 13% in FY26 to 155,000 tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Tire crushing volumes increased by 13% in FY26 to 155,000 tons per annum due to an increase in capacity and utilization.

orders_capacity.claim: Exports delivered a robust 30% volume growth in FY26 over the last financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: Also, it is worth mentioning that exports continuing to be a strong growth catalyst for us with the company delivering a robust 30% volume growth in FY26 over last financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: The inventory of accrued EPR credits up to March 31, 2026, was fully monetized within Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: The inventory of accrued EPR credits up to 31st March 2026 was fully monetized within Q1 FY27.

capital_allocation.claim: Rs. 5 Cr was allocated to R&D for FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Rs. 5 Cr. was allocated to R&D for FY27.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board has recommended a final dividend of INR3.25 per equity share for FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with our commitment to delivering sustainable value to our shareholders, I am pleased to inform the Board has recommended a final dividend of INR3.25 per equity share for FY26.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised approximately INR78 crores through a QIP during Q1 FY26, which are now fully deployed.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q1 FY26, the company successfully raised approximately INR78 crores through a QIP, attracting participation from leading institutional investors like ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund, JM Financial Mutual Fund and Bank of India Mutual Fund. These proceeds are now fully deployed.

capital_allocation.claim: Total debt declined by 10% to INR121 crores in FY26 from INR134 crores in the previous financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: Balance sheet strength improved in FY26 with debt declining 10% to INR121 crores from INR134 crores in the previous financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash flow grew by 60% to INR57 crores during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: The company generated healthy cash flow from operating activities, which grew by 60% to INR57 crores during the year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operations in Oman were temporarily impacted by the West Asia conflict, resulting in relatively subdued volumes.
risks_headwinds.quote: operations in Oman were temporarily impacted by the West Asia conflict, resulting in relatively subdued volumes.

risks_headwinds.claim: The West Asia conflict led to temporary bitumen supply shortages and elevated prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: The West Asia conflict led to temporary bitumen supply shortages and elevated prices, creating a stronger demand for our bitumen as a cost-effective alternative for road infrastructure projects.

risks_headwinds.claim: Mbodla and Saudi Arabia reported a combined loss of around INR53 lakhs owing to initial start-up costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Mbodla and Saudi Arabia reported have combined loss of around INR53 lakhs owing to initial start-up costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Mbodla Investment Pty Ltd. and Tinna Rubber Arabia Ltd. reported a combined loss of Rs. 0.53 crore owing to initial start-up costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Mbodla Investment Pty Ltd. (South Africa) and Tinna Rubber Arabia Ltd. (Saudi Arabia) reported a combined loss of Rs. 0.53 crore owing to initial start-up costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management revised the Saudi Arabia project timeline due to evolving geopolitical uncertainties in West Asia and the GCC region.
risks_headwinds.quote: Management has prudently revised the project implementation timeline in light of evolving geopolitical uncertainties in West Asia and the GCC region, as ongoing supply chain and logistics disruptions continue to impact the broader industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: TP Buildtech's performance was impacted by currency fluctuations, crude oil volatility, and elevated polymer prices driven by the Middle East crisis.
risks_headwinds.quote: TP Buildtech's performance was impacted by currency fluctuation, crude oil volatility and elevated polymer prices driven by the Middle East crisis.

risks_headwinds.claim: Oman plant performance was impacted by higher raw material costs and export disruptions from Middle East geopolitical tensions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Performance in Oman was impacted by higher raw material costs during the year and export disruptions arising from geopolitical tensions in Middle East during the last quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Commencement of capital works for the 24,000 tons per annum tire recycling facility in Saudi Arabia was delayed due to Middle East tensions.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, due to the Middle East tensions, we thought it prudent to delay the commencement of the capital works and we are closely monitoring the situation.

management_commitments.claim: The company allocated INR5 crores towards research and development in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We had mentioned in the past, and we are renewing our commitment to innovation by allocating INR5 crores towards research and development in FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The PCMB business is expected to contribute 10% of FY27 revenue.
management_commitments.quote: With enhanced manufacturing capabilities and strong business momentum, this division is expected to contribute 10% of FY '27 revenue.

management_commitments.claim: The ongoing 3,500 MTPA MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The ongoing 3,500 MTPA MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 FY27, increasing the Company's total MRP capacity to 20,000 MTPA.

management_commitments.claim: Recovered Carbon Black production is scheduled to commence in Q3 FY27, followed by stabilization and commercial sales in Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Recovered Carbon Black (rCB) production is scheduled to commence in Q3 FY27, followed by operational stabilization and commercial sales in Q4 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Transition of customers for steel abrasives distribution will start from Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Transition of customers will start from Q4FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Commencement of crumb rubber production in South Africa is expected in Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Commencement of crumb rubber production is expected in Q2 FY27, with timelines impacted by supply chain disruptions arising from the West Asia conflict.

management_commitments.claim: Construction for the Saudi Arabia plant is expected to begin in mid-FY27, subject to normalization of the situation in the Middle East.
management_commitments.quote: A 13,000-square-metre plot has been allocated to Tinna, with construction expected to begin in mid-FY27, subject to normalization of the situation in the Middle East.

management_commitments.claim: The company has earmarked INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to investing in the business and have earmarked a further INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and '28.

management_commitments.claim: Nearly 50% of power requirements are expected to be met through renewable sources starting from FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Nearly 50% of our power requirements are expected to be met through renewable sources from FY27 onwards, supporting both our ESG objectives and cost efficiency efforts.

management_commitments.claim: PCMB business contribution to overall turnover is expected to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect the contribution from the PCMB business to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27, supported by strong business momentum.

management_commitments.claim: Polymer compounding facility capacity in Haryana is expected to reach 18,000 tons per annum by the end of Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: In line with our expansion strategy, we are enhancing the capacity of our polymer compounding facility in Haryana, which is expected to reach 18,000 tons per annum by the end of Q1 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: TPO production is expected to stabilize by the end of Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The TPO production is expected to stabilize by the end of Q1 FY27, while trial productions of the rCB plant is scheduled to begin in Q2 FY27 and we expect both the plants to be in full operation by Q3 of FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
